thread:
maria: quick heads-up — planning Spark Labs launch posts + a short webinar for next Tue. want to run a tiny PLG experiment: offer a small free credits grant on webinar signup + surface 3 prompt templates in onboarding. aim: activation (first 5 API calls), and baseline token cost. thoughts?

alex: love it. metric suggestion: pct of signups who make >=1 API call within 48h, and median tokens/use in that window. add a vanity metric for webinar attendees who convert to paid trial.

sam: do we have cohorts? i recommend split by source: organic blog vs webinar signups. treat webinar + credits as one arm, webinar only as control. keep sample small — 1k signups each.

maria: yes — cohort by source. goal is to validate whether credits + prompt templates increase first-call rate. kpis: first-call %, time-to-first-call, token consumption per first-call.

olivia: drafting copy options for launch post + webinar CTA. two quick variants:
- social variant A: "Join Spark Labs: 45-min live demo + a free $5 starter credit to kick off your first prompt. Learn building blocks + prompt templates."
- social variant B (short): "Live demo + $5 starter credit — ship an LLM feature in minutes. RSVP."

natalie: for routing — if someone registers via webinar form we should set a tag "webinar_credit_2026-03" and trigger onboarding flow that surfaces the 3 prompt templates. also add a task to ensure credits land in account within 5 min of registration.

sam: on the experiment implementation: feature-flag names: "sparklabs.credit-pilot.v1" and "sparklabs.promptpack.v1". Enrollment logic: randomize at registration, but ensure dedup by email. Logging: include cohort, flow-enter_ts, credit_granted_ts, first_api_call_ts.

alex: need the benchmark narrative to include expected baselines. current GA baseline (organic free-tier signups): first-call rate ~18% within 48h. hypothesize credit+templates -> +8-12ppt.

maria: timeline: draft copy by Fri EOD, landing page + webinar RSVP by Mon, promo social posts Tue morning, webinar Wed evening. can we compress to ship next-week?

olivia: i can get copy + 2 visual thumbnails by Thu. sharing microcopy here (thread):
- Email subject: "Get $5 credit when you join Spark Labs — live demo Wed"
- Webinar short blurb: "Hands-on demo + 3 ready-to-use prompt templates. Attendees get $5 starter credit."

sam: quick config snippet for routing/flagging (will paste to infra channel if folks want):
```
register -> set tag: webinar_credit_2026-03
if featureflag(sparklabs.credit-pilot.v1) == on:
  grant_credits(user_id, 500)  # cents + internal units mapping
  log(event: credit_granted, user_id, ts)
```

maria: nice. onboarding UX: which 3 prompt templates? we said: quick chat assistant, code helper, and content summarizer. keep them lightweight and pre-filled.

olivia: sample prompt titles: "Customer Support Triage", "JS Debug Assistant", "Meeting Notes Summarizer". each has 1-sentence benefit callout.

natalie: ops checklist: 1) ensure KYC/abuse checks for credit grant, 2) monitor for spam accounts, 3) rate-limit credit redemption to 1x per org.

alex: experiment analysis plan: run for 2 weeks or until 2k enrollments. primary comparison: webinar_with_credit_vs_without. use both relative lift and 95% CI.

maria: assigning: olivia — final copy + assets by Thu. sam — flag + routing snippet & smoke test by Mon. natalie — ops gating & abuse checks by Mon. alex — analysis dashboard (funnel + token cost) by Wed. i'll coordinate webinar logistics.

launch-bot: created event "webinar: spark labs - credit pilot" for 1764688000 (Wed 18:00) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team — small follow-ups: keep promo cadence light (2 social posts, 1 email to seed list). capture UTM for source segmentation. :thumbsup:
